svg.title: Token Quotient demo: the quote before a big AI job, the nightly installments, the bill after
svg.desc: A terminal in three phases. 1, the quote: the user asks Claude Code for a big job; Quotient's choice window shows three levels, each with its total, time and share of the 5-hour and weekly limits (good and max do not fit in the 5 hours), the user picks good, then the pace, 4 days at about 400k a night, and a second window sets the first night, the time and what the PC does after. 2, the installments: four nights, each one wakes the PC, works up to the cap and sleeps again. 3, the bill: real cost 1.59M against 1.6M quoted, 1 h 22 min of work against about 1 h 20 min, and what is left of the 5 hours and of the week, in percent and in millions of weighted tokens of each ceiling.

text.tspan: Write the user guide: 12 chapters, with examples. Big job.
all today: does not fit in what is left of the 5 hours
4 days: about 400k a night, ~20 min each
apart, now: one session on its own
user-guide · 4 installments · cap 420k a night · measured in pieces · the PC wakes on its own
· expected about 1 h 20 min · time learned
The next quote starts from these numbers: what is left, and how much 1% holds.
Quotient · 5-hour: 12% used, 88% left (~0.9M of ~1.0M wt) · week: 38% used, 62% left (~4.3M of ~7.0M wt)
Quotient · 5-hour: 0% used, 100% left (~1.0M of ~1.0M wt) · week: 61% used, 39% left (~2.7M of ~7.0M wt)
